meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Linear 工单评论转为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队用 Linear 管理任务并希望直接在聊天中跟进评论。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Linear for task management and wants to follow up comments in chat.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会接入Linear工单评论线程。每次有新评论都会自动回复，无需@提及。每个工单线程成为一个独立对话。
howto.when: 当Linear工单上有人发表评论时触发；所有评论都会触发，无需@提及。

say.text: 这个工单的最新进展是什么？
请总结这个issue的讨论要点。
请帮我分析这个bug并提出建议。
say.note: 直接评论即可触发，无需@。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude connects to Linear issue comment threads. Every new comment is automatically answered without needing @mention. Each issue thread becomes an isolated conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever someone comments on a Linear issue; every comment triggers it, no @mention required.

say_en.text: What's the latest status of this issue?
say_en.note: Claude will reply to your comment automatically.

say_en.text: Summarize the key points of this thread.
say_en.note: Claude answers based on the thread content.

say_en.text: Help me analyze this bug and suggest next steps.
